catalog_item.name: Travel Agency Voyage - Complete Travel Booking Platform

post.title: Explore the Travel Agency Voyage Master Package
post.author: Voyage Travel Agency Team
post.summary: Discover the complete Travel Agency Voyage application suite—featuring automated CI/CD deployments, Firebase backend integration, Gemini AI capabilities, and interactive web games.
post.content:
The Travel Agency Voyage platform is a full-featured web solution designed for modern travel management and online booking experiences. Packed with automated deployment pipelines via GitHub Actions (CodeQL & Deploy), robust security rules, and seamless Firebase configuration, this package offers a complete digital agency setup.

### Key Features:
- **Database & Data Store:** Pre-configured JSON data (`data/database.json`) for destination and booking management.
- **Firebase Integration:** Secure Firestore security rules, Firebase Blueprint configurations, and Applet setup.
- **AI Integration:** Integrated Gemini AI configuration models for smart recommendations and itinerary generation.
- **CI/CD Ready:** Automated code analysis via CodeQL and effortless deployment workflows.
- **Interactive Features:** Built-in web features, interactive components, and standard static asset hosting.
